name: Greyseed Extract
description: User gains 2 Glory Hearts for the rest of the scene (lost first). Suffers -1 die to Might & Grace while Hearts last.
overdose: Stamina becomes 0 and user falls unconscious. Recovers 1 Stamina/turn. Regains consciousness at 3 Stamina.

name: Sacred Water
description: User ignores Overdose effects for the rest of the scene.

name: Filtered Murksap
description: User gains +2 die to Insight & Focus checks for the rest of the scene.
overdose: User loses 1 Soul. If no Soul, lose 1 Heart instead.

name: Windweald Mint
description: User suffers -2 die to all checks, but Insight vs mental spells gain 2 automatic successes until end of scene.
overdose: User hallucinates and loses all senses but touch until end of scene.

name: Octopamine
description: User goes Berserk (as Berserk Weapon Art). After rage ends, lose 1 Soul.
overdose: User cannot discern friend/foe. For 3 rounds, attacks nearest target (even if dead).

name: Spiderbite
description: User suffers 1 Paralytic Venom. Paralytic Venom does not degrade/burn. Incoming poisons reduced to DoT/Debuff 1.
overdose: User cannot spend Stamina to burn off DoT until end of scene.

name: Icevein Root Powder
description: User gains 1 DR for 3 rounds.
overdose: User loses 1 Stamina. If no Stamina, take 1 Off-Balance.

name: Beetlebulk
description: User gains +2 Might for 3 rounds.
overdose: User suffers -2 Insight for 3 rounds.

name: Blood Salts
description: User gains 1 Glory Stamina (fades if not used in 3 rounds).
overdose: User loses Hearts equal to current Glory Stamina.

name: Luma Dust
description: User gains +2 Speed for 3 rounds.
overdose: Takes 1 unsoakable damage whenever ending turn with Stamina left, for 3 rounds.

name: Roach Milk
description: User gains Heal over Time (2), functions like DoT but restores Hearts.
overdose: User cannot receive healing for 1 round.

name: Mutagen
description: Grants a trait (-4 to +4 Hunger cost). Effect is a 10-stack Status. Can be force-fed for 1 Stamina (resist with free Might check).
overdose: Suffers 2 unsoakable damage from body rejection.

name: Widow’s Embrace
description: User gains Poisonous (Toxic Blood) until next rest.
overdose: User drops to Death's Door and loses 1 Stamina/turn until healed.

name: Gutbrew
description: -1 Insight & Grace. Grants 1 DR (non-stacking). Lasts scene. Restores 5 Belly.
overdose: User vomits, loses Belly as if rested, alcohol Strain reset.

name: Grasswine
description: -1 Grace. +1 die bonus on all social checks (made by/against user). Stacks. Lasts scene. Restores 5 Belly.
overdose: User vomits, loses Belly as if rested, alcohol Strain reset.

name: Bugbeer
description: +1 Might (non-stacking). -1 Insight & Grace. Lasts scene. Restores 10 Belly.
overdose: User vomits, loses Belly as if rested, alcohol Strain reset.

name: Shroom Ale
description: -1 Grace. Grants +1 Shell (non-stacking). Lasts scene. Restores 5 Belly.
overdose: User vomits, loses Belly as if rested, alcohol Strain reset.

name: Golden Whiskey
description: -1 Insight until end of scene. Restores 5 Belly. Grants 2 Glory Pluck (fades on rest).
overdose: User vomits, loses Belly as if rested, alcohol Strain reset.

name: Mead
description: -1 Insight. Grants 1 DR (non-stacking). +1 die social checks. +1 Glory Stamina die (fades on rest). Restores 10 Belly.
overdose: User vomits, loses Belly as if rested, alcohol Strain reset.

name: Amber Brandy
description: -1 Grace. Grants 1 DR (non-stacking). Restores 5 Belly. Grants 2 Glory Pluck (fades on rest).
overdose: User vomits, loses Belly as if rested, alcohol Strain reset.

name: Sunshine
description: -1 Insight. Grants +3 Shell (decreases by 1 each time user takes damage, refreshes with new drink). Restores 10 Belly. Grants 2 Glory Pluck (fades on rest).
overdose: User vomits, loses Belly as if rested, alcohol Strain reset.
